name: Literature
summary: Six-player partnership asking game where teams collect 6-card half-suits by memory and deduction.
rules_text: From a 52-card deck remove all four 8s, leaving 48 cards = eight half-suits: low 2-7 and high 9-A in each suit. Six players in two teams of three sit alternately; eight can play 4v4. Deal all cards face down: 8 each for six, 6 each for eight. No showing to teammates. On your turn you must ask one opponent for a specific rank+suit you do not hold, while you hold another card of that same half-suit, and the opponent still has cards. If they have it they must give it face-up and you ask again. If not, turn passes to them. You may lay down a half-suit you hold complete. You may also claim a half-suit you believe your team collectively holds by naming who holds each of the six cards. If correct your team wins it, if wrongly located cards are cancelled, if opponent holds any card of it opponents win it. Players with no cards cannot be asked. When one team is out of cards the other must claim remaining half-suits. Most half-suits wins.
rating_reason: Team quartet asking game, memory and coordination, allies supported
